# Security Policy

## Supported versions

| Version | Supported |
| --- | --- |
| 0.2.x | Yes |
| < 0.2 | No |

## Reporting a vulnerability

Report security vulnerabilities to the project owner privately. Do not open
a public issue for a suspected vulnerability.

Include: description, reproduction steps, impact assessment, and suggested fix
if available.

## Contact

Report vulnerabilities to: lazy9sascha@agentmail.to

## Response

The maintainer will acknowledge the report within 7 days and provide a fix
timeline. Fixes are released as patch versions.
